lines.speaker: Philistine
lines.text: Our champion has fallen! Retreat! Back to the ridge!

lines.speaker: Soldier
lines.text: He has fallen! The Lord has delivered us!

lines.speaker: Crowd
lines.text: The Lord has given us victory!

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: The Lord was with me. The victory belongs to him.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: A shepherd faced a giant with faith and courage. David prevailed, and the people of Israel were delivered.
